executive_summary: Is lecture mein humne seekha ki Search Engine Optimization (SEO) kya hota hai aur websites ko search engines par rank karne ke liye HTML meta tags, viewport settings, aur image alt attributes kaise configure karte hain. Humne Chrome DevTools ke Google Lighthouse tool se website audit karna aur Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) optimize karna bhi seekha.
learning_objectives: SEO fundamentals aur on-page meta tag strategies samajhna
<meta> description aur mobile viewport tags implement karna
Chrome DevTools Lighthouse panel se performance audit run karna
Core Web Vitals metrics (LCP, INP, CLS) ke thresholds optimize karna

sections.heading: 1. SEO Fundamentals & Essential Meta Tags
sections.content: SEO ka goal search engines jaise Google par organic traffic lana hota hai. HTML ke <head> section mein <meta name='description'> Google search snippet decide karta hai. Mobile devices ke liye responsive viewport meta tag zaroori hota hai.
code_snippets:
<meta name="description" content="Master modern HTML, SEO, and web development with Sigma Batch.">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

sections.heading: 2. Google Lighthouse Audit & Performance Analysis
sections.content: Chrome DevTools ke andar Lighthouse tab se hum 4 categories check karte hain: Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, aur SEO. Lighthouse audit se heavy images aur slow resources ka pata lagta hai.
code_snippets:
<!-- Chrome DevTools: F12 -> Lighthouse -> Analyze page load -->
<link rel="icon" type="image/x-icon" href="favicon.ico">

sections.heading: 3. Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS)
sections.content:
Core Web Vitals user experience ke 3 core dimensions measure karte hain:
- LCP (Largest Contentful Paint): Largest visible content load hone ka time (< 2.5s is good).
- INP (Interaction to Next Paint): Page par user clicks/taps ki overall responsiveness (< 200ms is good; March 2024 me FID ki jagah aaya).
- CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift): Content ka sudden unexpected shift (< 0.1 is good).

definitions_and_terms.definition: Search Engine Optimization: Google par website rank karane ki technique.
Largest Contentful Paint: Page ka main hero content render hone ka time.
Interaction to Next Paint: Clicks aur keystrokes par UI responsiveness latency (< 200ms).
Cumulative Layout Shift: Loading ke dauran visual stability ka score.

common_pitfalls: Viewport meta tag bhool jana jisse mobile screen par layout shrink ho jata hai.
Images ke explicit width/height dimensions omit karna jisse CLS score drop hota hai.
Long blocking JavaScript tasks run karna jo INP latency ko 200ms se upar le jati hain.
revision_checklist: Head tag mein meta description added hai?
Responsive viewport meta tag correctly defined hai?
Sabhi images par meaningful alt text diya hai?
Lighthouse SEO score 90+ achieve hua hai?
LCP <= 2.5s aur INP <= 200ms optimize hui hai?
